)

0x37
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
FrIf_CtrlIdx

FrIf_ChnlIdx
Index of the FlexRay Channel to address in scope of the FlexRay
controller FrIf_CtrlIdx.
Parameters (in)
FrIf_BranchIdx

transceiver to which the API call has to be applied.
Parameters (inout)
None

None

Std_ReturnType

Description
Wraps the FlexRay Transceiver Driver API function FrTrcv_DisableTransceiverBranch. The
enum value "FR_CHANNEL_AB" shall not be used.
